Problem Statement
Read a decimal number between 0 and 15 and print its 4-bit binary equivalent, using % and / to extract each bit.
Description
Read an integer num between 0 and 15. Extract its binary bits one at a time using the % operator (which gives the current least significant bit) and the / operator (which removes that bit), repeating this four times since the result always fits in 4 bits. Print the four bits together, most significant bit first, with no spaces between them.
Input Description
A single line containing an integer num (0 ≤ num ≤ 15).
Output Description
Print the 4-bit binary equivalent of num, as four digits with no spaces.
Sample Input
10
Sample Output
1010
